tools.name: screener_top
tools.description:
Top subnets by Cipher heat score. n up to 50. category filters by tag
    (e.g. 'inference', 'training', 'agents', 'finance', 'tools').

tools.name: subnet_detail
tools.description:
Full detail for one subnet: price, 1d/1w/1m change, volume, liquidity,
    identity tags, research conviction, watchlist.

tools.name: subnet_bars
tools.description: Recent OHLC bars for a subnet (newest last). limit max 500.

tools.name: alphagap_flow
tools.description:
AlphaGap momentum snapshot: flow_score (momentum+whale+volume),
    whale_signal ('accumulating'/'distributing'), whale_ratio, composite,
    dev, eval scores. High flow = strong momentum.

tools.name: search_subnets
tools.description: Search subnets by name substring. limit max 25.

tools.name: tao_price
tools.description:
Current TAO USD price + 24h change (from the screener's tao_price_usd
    table).

tools.name: tao_forecast
tools.description:
7-day TAO price forecast (median + p10/p90 bands) from the local
    Ephemeris-clone forecaster (Chronos-2).

tools.name: trader_state
tools.description:
Live AA subnet-trader decision state (read-only window): current
    equity + 24h trend, circuit-breaker status, open positions, and the most
    recent entry/exit/flow-gate decisions from the driver log. Same data as
    the paid x402 endpoint /api/premium/trader-stream, exposed free here for
    a
